name: Nexoya
description:
Nexoya is an AI-powered platform for cross-channel attribution, prediction, budget optimization, and scenario simulation, used by enterprise performance marketing teams at brands like Generali, Vodafone Italia, and ITA Airways.
This connector brings your Nexoya portfolio data into Claude. Ask about attribution-adjusted performance per channel or campaign, pull daily and aggregate metrics for any date range, review the latest AI budget optimization and its proposed changes, and inspect funnel steps, events, labels, and portfolio contents; all through conversation instead of dashboards.
Typical questions: "How did our Q2 portfolio perform against target CPA?", "What did the latest optimization change and why?", "Which channel drove the most attributed conversions last month?", "Compare daily spend and conversions across our portfolios."

Requires a Nexoya account. All data access is read-only and scoped to the portfolios your Nexoya user can see. Only aggregated, non-personal marketing data is exposed; Nexoya is privacy-by-default with no pixel or cookie data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Nexoya to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Nexoya to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.nexoya.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Nexoya MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nexoya provides these MCP tools: get-portfolio-attribution-performance, get-portfolio-daily-metrics, get-portfolio-latest-optimization, get-portfolio-performance, list-portfolio-contents, list-portfolio-events, list-portfolio-funnel-steps, list-portfolio-labels, list-portfolios, and list-user-teams.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Nexoya?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Nexoya in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Nexoya requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Nexoya is developed by Nexoya ltd.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
